title: alisma echinocarpum
intro: Alisma echinocarpum, commonly known as Alisma plantago-aquatica or water plantain, is a plant species belonging to the family Alismataceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to help with diabetes and obesity due to its reported health benefits of lowering blood sugar levels and aiding in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of Alisma echinocarpum include acting as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, helping to reduce swelling, ease pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Alisma echinocarpum include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
